title: Whole-Group Push-and-Stretch Circuit
description: The team alternates short pushing bursts with a stretch station, raising the heart rate gradually while keeping the warm-up genuinely dynamic rather than static.

content.objective: Raise the heart rate gradually through alternating push bursts and stretch stations.
content.setup: Players line up on the baseline with the court open ahead.
instructions: Push easily to the free-throw line, then stop for a 10-second shoulder stretch.
Push on to half court, then stop for a 10-second trunk rotation stretch.
Push back to the baseline at a slightly higher effort than the way out.
Repeat the full circuit twice, raising the pace each round.
coachingPoints: Keep the stretches brief and dynamic, not long static holds.
Build the pace gradually across the two rounds.
Keep the group moving together rather than spreading out.
commonMistakes: Pushing at full speed on the very first round.
Turning the stretch stops into a long break instead of a brief reset.
Skipping the easier reps and going straight to full intensity.
content.safety: Check the court is clear of other equipment before the group starts moving.
